name: Céline Imart - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the European Commission's plan to lend Jordan up to 500 million euros. This comes on top of an earlier 500 million euro loan agreed in 2025. The money is meant to help Jordan cope with high public debt, slow growth, high unemployment and the cost of hosting about 3.8 million refugees. The Parliament asks the Commission to keep it fully informed about the economic reforms Jordan must carry out and about whether Jordan respects democracy, the rule of law and human rights.

- The Parliament backs a new loan of up to 500 million euros to Jordan, paid in three instalments.
- Jordan must first agree reform conditions with the Commission and meet democratic and human rights standards.
- The Commission must report regularly to the Parliament on progress before any money is paid out.
